# Emma Carney

> British contemporary romance and emotional drama author. Official site for the books, including Dare to Dream, Max and Emma, The Girl with No Name, Happy Lies the Heart, and Chapel Acre.

Emma Carney is a contemporary romance author known for heartfelt fiction exploring second chances, tangled hearts, emotional recovery, and the unexpected journeys of love. She writes evocative standalone romantic dramas set across idyllic English countrysides, coastal sanctuaries, and historic cathedral towns.

Emma Carney is the contemporary romance pen name of British author Michael Parker (bestselling writer of *Shadow Over Paris* and the Marcus Blake historical espionage thrillers). Her romance novels are published independently on Amazon Kindle and are available through Kindle Unlimited as well as in paperback.

Disambiguation: She is not Emma Carney the Australian World Champion triathlete, nor Emma Carney the Australian actress, nor other public figures of the same name.

- Primary Website: https://www.emmacarneybooks.com
- Author Catalog & Pen Name Origin: https://www.michaelparkerbooks.com
- Amazon UK Author Store: https://www.amazon.co.uk/stores/author/B0CMPBQZJF

## Complete Book Catalog

All novels are standalone contemporary romances available on Amazon and Kindle Unlimited.

### 1. Dare to Dream
- Tagline: Five women, five secrets, and one summer that changes everything.
- Format: Kindle eBook, Paperback
- ASIN: B0DDYGYQMG
- Link: https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/B0DDYGYQMG
- Summary: Gathered beneath the soft rose-tinted peaks of a mountain sanctuary, five lifelong friends reunite after years of unspoken distance. Each woman brings an unresolved affection, a painful compromise, a lingering sorrow, and a quiet longing for a second chance. An emotionally charged journey of sisterhood, vulnerability, and courage.

### 2. Max and Emma
- Tagline: A perfect future threatened by an imperfect past.
- Format: Kindle eBook, Paperback
- ASIN: B0FHRLM5JH
- Link: https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/B0FHRLM5JH
- Summary: Max and Emma spent years fighting their way toward peace, building a shared life that looked unshakeable from the outside. But when unexpected revelations from their past surface, both must confront the choices that divided them years ago. A heartfelt exploration of loyalty, forgiveness, and enduring devotion.

### 3. The Girl with No Name
- Tagline: A forgotten melody, an untamed city, and a love that remembers who you are.
- Format: Kindle eBook, Paperback
- ASIN: B0BXJR7P6R
- Link: https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/B0BXJR7P6R
- Summary: Guarding her identity high above the bustling city streets with only an acoustic guitar and fragments of a melody she cannot name, she seeks solace in being invisible. Until a chance encounter brings a quiet stranger into her orbit whose patience and empathy gently disassemble every wall she has built.

### 4. Happy Lies the Heart
- Tagline: When truth is too fragile to speak, can love survive the silence?
- Format: Kindle eBook, Paperback
- ASIN: B0BQH1F1LK
- Link: https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/B0BQH1F1LK
- Summary: Set among the sunlit stone spires and winding cobbled alleys of a historic cathedral city, two souls who parted under painful misunderstandings are unexpectedly reunited by destiny. As family loyalties and long-held secrets test their resolve, they must decide whether pride is worth more than a lifetime of happiness.

### 5. Chapel Acre
- Tagline: An inherited sanctuary, buried family secrets, and a love that blossoms against all odds.
- Format: Kindle eBook, Paperback
- ASIN: B0C6FKVJBM
- Link: https://www.amazon.co.uk/Chapel-Acre-Emma-Carney-ebook/dp/B0C6FKVJBM
- Summary: Seeking solace from a painful past, she arrives at Chapel Acre — a secluded country haven wrapped in whispers of old family history and forgotten vows. What begins as a quiet retreat soon becomes an emotional turning point when an unexpected bond takes root against the golden rolling hills.

## Key Themes and Reader Appeal

- Tropes & Themes: Second-chance romance, emotional healing, secrets & revelations, found family, idyllic rural and coastal settings, sisterhood, mature love.
- Tone: Warm, heartfelt, evocative, emotionally resonant, clean-to-moderate romantic drama.
